notes: All functional assertions passed: with POST /v1/admin/users mocked to return 409 {"error":{"message":"A user with this email already exists"}}, the error toast displayed exactly that backend message (.codemie-toast-err), and the modal stayed open with email/username/name values intact. The test is marked FAIL only because of this skill's hard 'any console error is a hard fail' rule: src/store/user.ts createUser()'s catch block calls console.error('Failed to create user:', error) before toasting, by the same established pattern already used by every other admin mutation in that file (assignUserToProject, updateUserProjectRole, unassignUserFromProject, searchUsers, etc.) -- so this is pre-existing, codebase-wide convention, not a regression introduced by this feature. Flagging for human judgment rather than silently downgrading the result.
